research.summary: Data-center accelerator demand remains the primary revenue driver.
research.thesis: Sustained hyperscaler capex supports multi-year demand for the company's data-center GPU platform.
research.counterThesis: Customer concentration could compress long-run demand and pricing power.
risks: Export-control changes could restrict addressable market in key regions.
unknowns: Next-generation platform yield rates have not been publicly disclosed.
falsifiers: A sustained multi-quarter sequential decline in data-center segment revenue.

research.summary: Prior-cycle memory pricing commentary; current-quarter disclosures were not yet available at request time.
research.thesis: A multi-year memory upcycle supports margin expansion, based on the most recently available public data.
research.counterThesis: Memory markets are historically cyclical and a supply response could compress pricing sooner than assumed.
risks: Commodity memory pricing is historically volatile and cyclical.
unknowns: Most recent quarter's disclosures were not retrievable at generation time; figures reflect the prior public filing.
falsifiers: A sustained decline in spot DRAM or NAND pricing over consecutive quarters.
